description: Address all 5 review issues: lazy-load Office page for code splitting, add visibility detection to pause GPU rendering, add mobile/small-screen fallback, wire quick action buttons, and fix fragile event type assertions.
steps: Update App.tsx to lazy-load Office page with React.lazy + Suspense for code splitting
Create usePageVisibility hook to detect hidden tab state
Add paused prop to OfficeScene that switches frameloop to 'demand' when tab is hidden
Create useMediaQuery hook for responsive breakpoint detection
Create OfficeMobileFallback component with scrollable agent list and bottom-sheet detail view
Update Office.tsx to use mobile fallback on screens < 768px
Wire AgentDetailSidebar 'View Full Profile' button to navigate to /agents/:id
Replace fragile (e as unknown as { stopPropagation }) cast with proper ThreeEvent<MouseEvent> type from @react-three/fiber in AgentCharacter and ManagerCabin
acceptance_criteria: Office page is code-split into a separate chunk (not part of main bundle)
GPU render loop pauses when browser tab is hidden (frameloop='demand')
Small screens (< 768px) show a mobile-friendly list view instead of 3D canvas
View Full Profile button navigates to /agents/:id
No unsafe type casts remain - proper ThreeEvent types used
TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
findings: Code-split Office chunk is ~954KB (separate from main 783KB app chunk). Mobile fallback uses a bottom-sheet pattern for agent detail on small screens. The 'Assign New Task' and 'View Logs' buttons are wired as no-ops with comments, since those pages/features do not exist yet.
